en: A vintage sepia-toned postcard with ornate golden decorative borders and oak-leaf motifs, overlaid with cursive handwritten text. In the upper left corner there is a colored coat of arms showing a blue shield with a silver fish and a river scene, framed by green branches. The lower half of the card features a riverside panorama: a broad river with a few small boats in the foreground and a low, sandy or quarry-like bank with buildings along the opposite shore.
